personas.name: Amani
personas.summary: Can't read yet. Loves animals and tapping things. Plays on the family's budget Android tablet, usually for 10–15 minutes after nursery, with Mum nearby.
personas.needs: Everything spoken aloud; big targets; no failure states; lots of praise; quick wins.
personas.frustrations: Small buttons, text instructions, anything that takes too long to load.

personas.name: Zawadi
personas.summary: Amani's older sister. Learning to read and count to 100. Very motivated by collecting stickers and dressing up her buddy. Plays at home and in class.
personas.needs: Visible progress; rewards to save up for; feeling 'big' compared with her little brother.
personas.frustrations: Repeating lessons she already knows; her brother playing on her profile.

personas.name: Leo
personas.summary: Confident reader, obsessed with space and football. Likes challenges and getting things right first time.
personas.needs: Harder questions, real facts, a sense of mastery; less babyish feedback.
personas.frustrations: Being made to do easy stuff; slow celebrations that stop him moving on.

personas.name: Nia
personas.summary: Uses the app for maths practice and planets. Has her own PIN. Wants it to feel grown-up.
personas.needs: A cooler look, typed answers, her own goals, privacy from younger siblings.
personas.frustrations: Cartoonish UI, being treated like a little kid.

personas.name: Grace
personas.summary: Mum of Amani and Zawadi. Works full-time, uses an Android phone. Wants screen time that is actually educational and wants to add the family's own world (their farm, their grandparents) to lessons.
personas.needs: Fast set-up; clear progress at a glance; making a custom lesson in under 5 minutes; control of screen time.
personas.frustrations: Ads, upsells aimed at kids, apps that need constant supervision.

personas.name: Tom
personas.summary: Leo's dad. Travels for work, checks progress from his phone and likes to award badges remotely for things Leo does at home.
personas.needs: View progress, award a badge, approve a wish from anywhere.
personas.frustrations: Being locked out because only one parent set up the account.

personas.name: Ms Priya
personas.summary: Teaches a class of 26 five-and-six-year-olds with 8 shared tablets and a projector. Makes her own weekly spelling and topic lessons.
personas.needs: Quick class set-up; assigning work to groups; seeing who's stuck; reusing and sharing lessons with colleagues.
personas.frustrations: Kids forgetting passwords; spending lesson time on logins; tools that don't work offline when the Wi-Fi drops.

personas.name: Joseph
personas.summary: Grace's uncle. Is improving his reading and wants to learn alongside the grandchildren. Uses the 'Add me too' adult profile.
personas.needs: Adult look; no childish tone; private progress; start at the right level.

personas.name: Sam
personas.summary: Runs a small primary school with 6 teachers. Buys the school licence and manages teacher seats.
personas.needs: Simple licence and seat management; data-protection paperwork; school-wide reports.
personas.frustrations: Per-teacher billing chaos; unclear data handling.

personas.name: Steve
personas.summary: Builds the product solo with Claude. Needs fast feedback, safe releases and content that can be added without code changes.
personas.needs: Automated checks, reliable deploys, a content pipeline.
